claim_text: Plasmodium contains multiple independent and compartment-specific genome-composition transitions.
evidence_required: High-quality species tree; independent transitions; annotation/LCR robustness
falsifier: Single clade/history or data quality explains pattern
allowed_language: May report observed composition states with independence grade; still not causal/adaptive — Gate A GO 2026-09-03: range 18.2-52.3%, grade A (Laverania+avian low, vivax+piroplasm high), 7/7 LOO retain gradient

claim_text: Base composition explains most global codon variation but not all synonymous choices.
evidence_required: AA-fixed nulls; local composition controls; phylogenetic robustness
allowed_language: Use candidate synonymous residual until robust — Gate B GO 2026-09-03: median 84.5% GC3 explains codon chi2-deviation (284/288 q<0.05 masked, small fragmented effect), 7 solid robust F,I,P,A,N,D,E + L provisional; genome-wide adaptive codon claim DOWNGRADED without M3 second layer (04 §7)

claim_text: A subset of amino-acid/protein architecture shifts exceeds mutational, phylogenetic and structural expectations.
falsifier: All shifts explained by background or LCR
allowed_language: Do not call adaptive before functional evidence — Gate B GO 2026-09-03: median 78.7% R2 CLR~genome_gc (14/20 GC-coupling q<0.05 masked slope-level, 13 robust GC-coupled), genome-wide adaptive AA claim DOWNGRADED without M3 second layer

claim_text: Stable sequence residuals encode stage-specific translational stress-response programs (Pf-specific only after Gate C PIVOT; cross-species wording DOWNGRADED).
evidence_required: Within-Pf TE/decay + tRNA-mod + drug panel + K13 mRNA = >=2 orthogonal layers + ART core phenotype; single species, no own perturbation
falsifier: No cross-species program; no causal sufficiency; no clinical target
allowed_language: Pf-scoped predictive language only; cross-species program language BANNED — Gate C PIVOT 2026-09-04 (EVID-M3-001 primary 13/36 + EVID-M3-003 0 hits). M4R: retained as boundary context, no longer sole M4 main line (D-036)

claim_text: Long-term composition evolution preconfigures lineage-specific drug or lifecycle stress responses.
evidence_required: Gate-D/M5 convergence: natural/experimental perturbation; explicit alternative mechanisms
falsifier: Only correlation with expression or phylogeny

claim_text: Composition-derived dependencies create conditional and relatively low-escape parasite vulnerabilities.
If translational residuals are weak, AT-rich repeats contribute to indel/CNV-mediated genome plasticity and escape.
allowed_language: Activate only if Gate B selects plasticity

claim_text: Composition-coupled site turnover (L2) partitions protein architecture differently from canonical adaptive/resistance substitutions.
evidence_required: L2 v2 (Grantham + QC + ML tree) + branch-aware upgrade + matched adaptive-site controls
falsifier: Partition disappears under matched conservation/structure/OG controls
allowed_language: May report observed partition with controls; do not call dual-adaptive-axes unless matched-control difference survives — L2 main-story fixed (D-036)

claim_text: Regulatory proteins (AP2/PUF/chromatin/RNA regulators) are enriched for composition-sensitive Asn/LCR/IDR properties beyond length/IDR-matched background.
evidence_required: Formal enrichment (GO/InterPro/curated sets, effect sizes) + IDR-counterfactual (given comparable IDR, regulatory IDRs unusually Asn-enriched)
falsifier: Enrichment explained by IDR fraction/length/expression/annotation alone
allowed_language: Do not call mechanism; enrichment is not co-option evidence — candidate only (D-036)

claim_text: Composition-shaped regulatory sequence variation is functionally co-opted into lifecycle/transmission (H-A) or ART-stress (H-C) regulation.
evidence_required: Lifecycle: stage-resolved + perturbation + natural-sequence experiment (GCN5-class); ART: stage-adjusted + acute×genotype + independent replication
falsifier: Stage-corrected signal vanishes; >=2 independent ART datasets null (C exits to boundary)
allowed_language: Must not write deliberately-designed-bottleneck / Asn-first-to-collapse / ART-resistance-implemented-through-axis / acute-mobilization-chronic-conservation as proven — hypotheses only (D-036)
